spans.s:
n. (-गं)
A pair of oxen.
E.
गो, and गोयुग a pair.

n. (-ष्ठं)
A cattle shed.
E.
गो, and गोष्ठ a shed.

f. (-ष्टिः)
A cow that has had one calf.
E.
गो a cow, and गृष्टि q. v. the same as the compound.

m. (-न्थिः)
1 Dried cow-dung.
2 A station for cows, a cowyard or house, &c.
E.
गो a cow, ग्रन्थ to arrange, and इन् aff.

m. (-हः)
Spoil, booty, capture of cattle.
E.
गो, and ग्रह seizing.

m. (-सः)
The ceremony of presenting grass to the cow when making atonement.
E.
गो, and ग्रास a mouthful.
